rootCause: Each non-empty sampled bucket is a meaningful cumulative counter delta, so the existing two-minute flush updates every dirty bucket. The avoidable overhead was a database SELECT for every already-known row on every flush.

implementation.durableRowCache: successful rows are cached per process; unknown keys are loaded from the database once, preserving restart recovery
implementation.dirtyOnlyFlush: pending buckets are swapped before flush and only those keys are written
implementation.skipUnchanged: zero-delta rows with no new provider are skipped
implementation.failureSafety: failed batches are merged back into pending state and retried
implementation.overlapSafety: observations arriving during a flush remain in the new pending map
